texts.li: The ground has thawed, and {A_nameDef} wants the whole colony out in the fields at first light before the sowing starts, to walk the rows together and say a few words over the seed. "Where I'm from, nobody planted a thing until it was blessed," {A_nameDef} says.\n\nIt would cost the colony a morning's work.

{A_nameDef} has been sorting seed by the window all week, and has asked the council for one morning: everyone in the fields at dawn, a handful of grain scattered for luck, and then the planting can begin.

[lowtech] Back in {A_nameDef}'s village, the first furrow of spring was blessed by everyone together, with a little grain thrown to the birds so they'd leave the rest. {A_nameDef} would like to do the same here.
[colony:Traditional] The colony keeps its customs, and {A_nameDef} has asked for one more: a blessing on the fields before the first seed goes in, with everyone there to see it.

li.label: Bless the fields together
li.outcome: The whole colony walked the rows at dawn while {A_nameDef} said the words. The planting started late, and nobody minded.

outcomes.li: [rain] It rained on the blessing, which {A_nameDef} declared the best possible sign. Everyone came back soaked and smiling.
[lowtech] {A_nameDef} threw the first handful of grain to the birds, and the colony followed the furrow one by one, each with a word for the year.

li.label: A quiet word at the field's edge
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} said the words alone at the edge of the field before breakfast, then went to fetch the seed.

li.label: Just get the seed in the ground
li.outcome: The sowing started at dawn as usual. {A_nameDef} planted the first row a little more carefully than the rest, and didn't say why.

texts.li: The snow has gone from the graves, and {A_nameDef} has been out to clear the winter's leaves off them. {A_nameDef} asks whether the colony might walk out there together one evening, everyone, and say the names of the dead out loud.

{A_nameDef} found weeds growing over one of the graves this morning and pulled them by hand. Now {A_nameDef} wants a day each spring when the whole colony walks to the graves together, tidies them, and remembers.
[trait:Kind] {A_nameDef} has picked the first flowers of the year, one for every grave, and asks the council if everyone could come and lay them down together.

li.label: Walk to the graves together
li.outcome: The colony walked to the graves at dusk, tidied them, and said every name out loud. A few stories came out that nobody had heard before.

outcomes.li: [trait:Kind] Everyone laid a flower on a grave, and {A_nameDef} said a few words for each of the dead. It took a long time, and nobody hurried it.
[rain] They walked out in the rain and stood at the graves anyway, saying the names over the noise of it. It felt right, somehow.

li.label: Those who want to can go
li.outcome: A handful of them went out with {A_nameDef} at dusk. The rest found something to do indoors.

li.label: The living have work to do
li.outcome: No walk. {A_nameDef} went out alone after dark and came back with mud on {A_possessive} knees.

texts.li: It's the hottest day yet, and {A_nameDef} wants the whole colony down at the water for the afternoon: tools down, boots off, and nobody back until they've been in up to the neck.
{A_nameDef} came back from the water this morning dripping and grinning, and has asked the council to let everyone have an afternoon of it. "One day a year," {A_nameDef} says. "That's all."
[trait:Ascetic] Even {A_nameDef}, who usually wants nothing, has asked for this: an afternoon in the water for everyone, on the hottest day of the year.

li.label: Everyone to the water
li.outcome: The colony spent the afternoon in the water, splashing and floating and arguing about who went in first. They walked back sunburnt and sleepy.

outcomes.li: {A_nameDef} was first in and last out. By evening there was a rope tied to a branch over the deepest part, and a list of who had swung from it.

li.label: A swim once the day's work is done
li.outcome: Work first, then the water. The light was going by the time they got there, but it was still warm, and nobody hurried back.

li.label: Keep everyone working
li.outcome: The afternoon passed in the heat at work. {A_nameDef} kept looking toward the water.

texts.li: The fields are bare and the stores are full, and {A_nameDef} wants a dance: the floor swept, the tables pushed back, someone on a drum, and everyone up on their feet until they can't stand.\n\nIt would cost nothing but a late night and a slow morning.
{A_nameDef} has been teaching a couple of the others an old harvest dance in the barn when they think nobody's watching, and has finally asked the council to make a night of it for everyone.
[lowtech] Where {A_nameDef} grew up, the last sheaf was carried in on someone's shoulders and the whole village danced around it. {A_nameDef} would like a dance here too, sheaf and all.
[trait:Kind] {A_nameDef} noticed how tired everyone looked bringing in the harvest, and asked the council for one night of music and dancing to make up for it.

li.label: Dance until the fire burns down
li.outcome: They danced until the fire was embers and the drummer's hands gave out. Even the ones who swore they couldn't dance were dragged up for at least one.

outcomes.li: [lowtech] The last sheaf went round the fire on {A_nameDef}'s shoulders, and the colony danced after it until the stars moved.

li.label: One dance, then bed
li.outcome: They had one dance, a good one, and went to bed pleased with themselves.

li.label: There's work in the morning
li.outcome: No dance. {A_nameDef} hummed the tune under {A_possessive} breath all through supper.

texts.li: There was frost on the ground this morning, the first of the year. {A_nameDef} wants to mark it the old way: one big pot of soup, the last of the garden thrown in, and everyone eating it together out of the same pot. It would take about {COUNT} raw food.

The water trough had ice on it at dawn. {A_nameDef} says a first frost deserves a first soup, and has already put the big pot on the fire, waiting for the council to say yes. It would need about {COUNT} raw food.

[trait:Gourmand] {A_nameDef} has been waiting all autumn for the first frost, because that's when the soup is made, and the soup is very important. About {COUNT} raw food, {A_nameDef} says, and worth every bite.

li.label: One big pot for everyone
li.outcome: The soup bubbled all afternoon and the whole colony ate it standing round the pot, breath steaming. It was the best thing anyone had eaten in weeks.

outcomes.li: [snow] Snow started falling while they ate, and they stayed out in it anyway, bowls in their hands, until the pot was scraped clean.

li.label: Soup for those working outside
li.outcome: A smaller pot went out to the ones working in the cold. The rest smelled it from indoors and were jealous.

li.label: Everything goes to the winter stores
li.outcome: The big pot went back on its hook. {A_nameDef} made the usual meals and said nothing about it.

texts.li: The nights are long and black, and {A_nameDef} wants one of them to be different: a lantern in every window and along every path, all lit at once at dusk, so the colony can be seen glowing from the hills.\n\nIt would burn a fair bit of wood.
{A_nameDef} has been making lanterns out of scraps in the evenings, dozens of them, and asks the council for one night to light them all.
[lowtech] Back home, on the darkest night of the year, every house set a candle in the window so the dead could find their way. {A_nameDef} asks if the colony could do the same.
[!lowtech] {A_nameDef} wants the lamps off for one winter night and lanterns lit instead, real flames, the way {A_pronoun} remembers it from childhood.

li.label: A lantern in every window
li.outcome: At dusk the lanterns were lit all at once, and the colony stood outside in the cold to look at itself glowing. Nobody wanted to go in.

outcomes.li: [snow] The lanterns lit up the falling snow, and for an hour the colony looked like something out of a story.
[lowtech] A candle burned in every window until dawn. {A_nameDef} sat up to keep them lit, and said a name at each one.

li.label: One lantern at the gate
li.outcome: One lantern burned at the gate all night. A few people went out to look at it before bed.

li.label: Save the fuel for the cold
li.outcome: The lanterns stayed in their box. The night was as dark as all the others.
